title: FLERP
description:
FLERP is an arcade tower defense roguelite where you defend your core from massive hordes of enemies. Recruit units from the shop and build up a team of powerful synergies to completely dominate the opposition.Gameplay• Recruit units from the shop

• Your units will automatically attack nearby enemies

• Gain gold and interest with every level, which can be spent in the shop

• Find powerful items to enhance your builds even further
Features• 40+ units to recruit

• 40+ items to find

• 14 classes with their own synergies
description_short: Fend off hordes of enemies in this arcade tower defense roguelite with autobattler elements. Build up a team of powerful synergies and become unstoppable.
